# sophosfirewall_dhcp_server (Data Source)

Looks up an existing DHCP server by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sophosfirewall_dhcp_server" "lan" {
  name = "LAN DHCP"
}

output "lan_dhcp_pools" {
  value = data.sophosfirewall_dhcp_server.lan.address_pools
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the DHCP server. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `accept_relay_requests` (Boolean) Accept requests forwarded by DHCP relay agents. Defaults to `false`.
- `address_pools` (Attributes Set) Dynamic IP lease ranges (at most 8). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--address_pools))
- `boot_file` (String) Boot file name for network boot, e.g. `pxelinux.0`.
- `boot_server` (String) Next (TFTP) server for network boot, as an IPv4 address or a fully qualified domain name.
- `conflict_detection` (Boolean) Check that an address is unused (ping) before leasing it. Defaults to `false`.
- `default_lease_time` (Number) Default lease time in minutes (1-43200).
- `dhcp_options` (Attributes Set) Additional DHCP options. See *Appendix A* of the SFOS command line help for the standard option codes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dhcp_options))
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name (suffix) handed out to clients.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the DHCP server is enabled. Read-only: the API does not allow switching it.
- `gateway` (String) Default gateway handed out to clients.
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `interface` (String) Name of the interface the server listens on, e.g. `Port1` or `Port2.100`.
- `max_lease_time` (Number) Maximum lease time in minutes (1-43200).
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the subnet handed out to clients (1-31), e.g. `24` for 255.255.255.0.
- `primary_dns` (String) Primary DNS server handed out to clients.
- `primary_wins` (String) Primary WINS server handed out to clients.
- `secondary_dns` (String) Secondary DNS server. Requires `primary_dns`.
- `secondary_wins` (String) Secondary WINS server. Requires `primary_wins`.
- `static_mappings` (Attributes Set) Static IP-MAC mappings (client reservations). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--static_mappings))

<a id="nestedatt--address_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `address_pools`

Read-Only:

- `end_address` (String) Last address of the range.
- `start_address` (String) First address of the range.


<a id="nestedatt--dhcp_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dhcp_options`

Read-Only:

- `code` (Number) Option code (1-255).
- `type` (String) Value type. Required for custom (non-standard) codes; for standard codes it may be omitted, and must match the standard type when set. `fqdn` is only valid for standard codes. One of `boolean`, `string`, `oneByte`, `twoByte`, `fourByte`, `oneByteArray`, `twoByteArray`, `fourByteArray`, `ipv4Addr`, `ipv4AddrArray`, `fqdn`.
- `value` (String) Option value.


<a id="nestedatt--static_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `static_mappings`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) Client hostname.
- `ip_address` (String) Reserved IPv4 address.
- `mac_address` (String) Client MAC address, e.g. `00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e`.
